pr_body:
This test would sometimes fail to keep the shards on their original nodes because the ignored `ShardRouting` objects had a different `allocationStatus` from the ones in the routing table. With this commit we fix the status at `NO_ATTEMPT` to avoid the problem.

Closes #91441
pr_comments:
Thanks Ievgen, all good points - see 8c80166624fb66e14f3be7cbe38ba47c861e9504.

Also this was really a `>bug` not a `>test`, except that it's not released yet so I've relabelled it as `>non-issue`.

I would have expected these shards to be claimed by the `PrimaryShardAllocator` and ignored by desired balance.
It's our old friend `UnassignedInfo#lastAllocationStatus` causing a mismatch between the ignored shard and the one in the routing table. In this case it's `FETCHING_SHARD_DATA`.
